title: What we build
blurb: Two products in the Adapdev portfolio today, and the bespoke practice they came out of. Click through for the ones that are live; the others have a note on where they're up to.

items.name: ADMS
items.tagline: Document management for Australian sole traders, small businesses and small law firms.
items.description: Client- and matter-centric filing with full-text search, Office add-ins, and a REST API. On-premises deployment, one-off licence, SQLite or SQL Server. In daily use.
meta: Sole traders • small business • small/medium law firms

items.name: Home Dialysis Tracker
items.tagline: Session logging for home haemodialysis patients.
items.description: A small, careful logbook for people doing their own haemodialysis at home: pre- and post-session vitals, machine readings, fluid balance, and a report their nephrology team can read. Local-first, offline-tolerant, patient-owned data.
meta: Home haemodialysis patients and their nephrology team
Local app, sync with the renal unit when convenient
In active development; early-access programme forming for 2027

items.name: Bespoke work
items.tagline: A piece of software shaped specifically for one business.
items.description: When a product in the catalogue doesn't quite fit, we take on bespoke engagements for Australian small business. Fixed-price per scope, local-first by default, written runbook on the way out.
meta: Small business where off-the-shelf part-solutions aren't enough
Scoping conversation → written design → fixed quote → build
Four to twelve weeks typical; longer builds release monthly
